threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused checking your Oyster card at the barriers, while the locals sail through without a second thought.
Caught a whiff of jollof rice on the 59 last night – must've been a party winding down. Nothing like late-night snacks in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a street musician playing accordion to a group of kids chasing pigeons by the canal. Classic Neukölln vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a spontaneous rave in the middle of a park on a Tuesday afternoon, complete with DJs and a massive sound system.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local by how they navigate the bus delays; they've got their own secret routes while everyone else is still waiting at the stop.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 31 Balboa, casually checking his watch as if he was heading to the Oscars. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but the locals hide in plain sight at the tiny bars on Carrer de Verdi, sipping vermut away from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their hesitance to use the tram; they still wait for the bus instead, oblivious to the efficiency.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's 'the Tube' and not just 'the Overground' – a real local knows the Overground is the way to go for Hackney.
Heard a bloke on the 59 arguing passionately with a cardboard cutout of a celebrity. Didn't even flinch when the driver shouted at him.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw an old man arguing passionately with a street musician about the proper way to play 'La Vie en Rose' on Sonnenallee—it felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find people debating the best currywurst while standing in line at a vegan café. It's a cultural mash-up that feels uniquely Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can spot the smell of sourdough from half a block away, but the ‘just working’ folks only notice when it’s fresh out the oven.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full clown suit juggling at the Civic Center stop while a rat casually strolled by. Just another Tuesday in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just a place to snap Gaudí pics; they miss the tiny bars where locals crowd for unpretentious vermut.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the overly careful way they navigate the metro stairs, clutching their backpacks like they might lose something precious.
